what_is_cookie.title: What is a cookie?
what_is_cookie.content: A cookie is a small text file placed on your device (computer, smartphone, tablet) when you visit the MarocAdsZone website. These cookies allow us to recognize you during your visits, provide you with a personalized browsing experience, and analyze traffic to improve our services.

necessary.title: Strictly necessary cookies
necessary.description: These cookies are essential for the website to function and for you to use its basic features (login, security, preferences). Without these cookies, certain features of the site may not work properly.
examples: Session cookies to manage user login

performance.title: Performance cookies
performance.description: These cookies allow us to measure audience traffic and improve the performance of MarocAdsZone by analyzing how you use the site (pages visited, time spent, errors encountered). The data collected is aggregated and anonymized.

functional.title: Functionality cookies
functional.description: These cookies remember your choices and preferences on the site to offer you a personalized experience (language, display preferences, search filters).
examples: Cookies for personalizing the ads you have viewed

advertising.title: Targeting and advertising cookies
advertising.description: These cookies may be placed on our site by our advertising partners to show you relevant ads based on your interests. These cookies also help measure the effectiveness of advertising campaigns.

management.title: Cookie management
management.description: When you first visit MarocAdsZone, a cookie banner allows you to manage your preferences. At any time you can:
items: Accept or refuse all or some cookies
Change your choices via your browser settings
Delete cookies already installed on your device
management.warning: Note: Refusing certain cookies may affect the proper functioning of some site features.

duration.title: Cookie retention period
duration.content: Cookies are kept for a maximum of 13 months after being placed on your device.
